title: OllamaOpt
description: Unified Intel AI Optimizer for local LLMs. Multi-tier acceleration strategy leveraging NPU, GPU, and CPU for maximum throughput.
detailedStory: Developed to optimize Ollama and local LLMs on Intel AI PCs (Core Ultra). It enables high-efficiency inference using IPEX-LLM and Vulkan fallbacks for mixed-hardware acceleration.

title: AdaptivIntelligenceCodex (AICodex)
description: Comprehensive knowledge base and code generation pipeline for Senior AI Engineers. Features an AI-powered Health and Oversight Data Analysis engine.
detailedStory: AICodex serves as the orchestration brain for AI-driven development. It integrates multi-provider LLM support (OpenAI/Gemini) for specialized data analysis and rapid architecture prototyping.

title: MediMixDash Saga
description: Interactive pharmacy simulation game leveraging Redux Saga for complex state orchestration. Experience the high-pressure workflow of a community pharmacist.
detailedStory: A deep dive into medical retail operations through gamification. This project simulates the multitasking challenges of a retail pharmacy, from prescription verification to inventory management, using a strictly typed Saga architecture for reliable state transitions.

title: WaveShooter: Healthcare Heroes
description: Fast-paced top-down wave shooter built with React, Three.js, and Vite. Repel waves of mutagens and viruses as healthcare heroes.
detailedStory: Performance-optimized 3D game showcasing snapping controls and readable wave pressure. Features Bosses, Milestones, and persistence logic for high scores and play time.

title: Surgical Procedure Listings App
description: Digital coordination platform for surgical procedure listings, reducing scheduling errors by digitizing manual paperwork in health facilities.
detailedStory: Real-world impact project that transformed manual paperwork into a streamlined digital workflow for surgical teams, reducing scheduling errors by 40%.

title: Onefit.app
description: Community-centric fitness and wellness platform connecting trainers with trainees through inspirational content and expert guidance.
detailedStory: A platform built to empower fitness enthusiasts through instruction and community connectivity. Features tailored training and nutrition plans.

title: 3D Studio
description: Advanced 3D visualization for medical assessment and physical therapy, indicating strain on body models.
detailedStory: A mock application using Three.js to indicate temperature, pain, and strain on 3D body models for physical therapy assessments.

title: PySwissChef
description: Django-powered automation showcase platform. A "Python Swiss Knife" for unifying scripting workflows into a reusable catalogue.
detailedStory: Elegantly presents and executes Python scripts via an admin portal with real-time output display and guest access for public interaction.

title: DB-To-HTML Form Generator
description: Fetches database tables/objects and generates basic HTML forms automatically, eliminating manual typing.
detailedStory: Rids developers of the tedious task of manually building HTML forms by generating them directly from the database schema, allowing focus on CSS.

title: SolidStateGE
description: Native Game Engine built with C++ (Early Stage). Focused on low-level graphics and performance.
detailedStory: An exploration into low-level graphics and engine core systems for high-performance builds, focusing on spatial partitioning and native systems.

title: Manzini Car Wash
description: Professional website design for a car wash business, focusing on high-fidelity UI and smooth user experience.
detailedStory: A sleek, modern design for a local business to enhance its digital presence and user interaction with professional aesthetic touches.

title: AdaptEngineV1
description: Search Engine, Web Crawler, and Resource Distribution Platform for small-data knowledge bases.
detailedStory: A specialized tool for navigating and indexing datasets safely, intended as a localized search engine and resource distributor.

title: Family Secret Santa
description: Interactive Secret Santa mini-app with JavaScript mechanisms for holiday gift sharing.
detailedStory: A festive design project built to simplify holiday gift sharing among family members using interactive JS mechanisms.

title: HNS-Housing VMS
description: Visit Management Information System (VMS) for housing projects, streamlining coordination across facilities.
detailedStory: A dedicated digital coordination platform for tracking and managing visitors in housing facilities, built as a dev project for HNS.

title: Homewire.app
description: E-commerce web application template for home services, featuring HTML, CSS, JS, and PHP.
detailedStory: A comprehensive e-commerce template designed for home service providers, focusing on simplicity and conversion for mobile and web.

title: Youth Lantern
description: Youth entrepreneurship and job application platform built with React, acting as an information hub.
detailedStory: An information hub and service provider platform empowering youth through employment opportunities and entrepreneurship tools.
